title: New Zealand Property Market: Plateau, Crash, or Continued Growth?
summary: Where are NZ house prices heading over the next five years? An evidence-based look at long-run data, credit conditions, and what happened in similar countries.

title: Tax Optimisation for New Zealand SMEs: What Actually Works
summary: A practical, officially sourced guide to legitimate tax optimisation for New Zealand SMEs and their owners, covering entity choice, deductions, provisional tax, and the incentives Parliament has deliberately provided.

title: NZ First-Home Buyers and the Property Market: Testing the Common Assumptions
summary: Who is buying homes in New Zealand, and what really drives prices? This brief tests common beliefs against official data from Stats NZ, the Reserve Bank, REINZ, and CoreLogic.

title: Why I Bought a Lotto Ticket This Week (Despite Knowing the Maths)
summary: Wednesday's Powerball is $35 million. The odds are 1 in 38.4 million. I bought a ticket anyway. Here is the logic: Bayes' theorem in a dairy, Taleb's barbell strategy, and the value of permission to dream.

title: AI and Digital Transformation: What the Data Actually Show
summary: OECD firm-level AI adoption more than doubled between 2023 and 2025. This brief looks at who is adopting, whether it is paying off, and what it means for auditors and corporate reporting.

title: AI Tokens: A New Asset Class With Real Accounting Questions
summary: AI-specific crypto tokens grew from USD 0.2 billion to about USD 25 billion by early 2026. The brief explains their economics, their volatility, and why FASB's new fair-value rule matters.

title: Blockchain and Cryptocurrency in Business: From Genesis Block to Mainstream
summary: A systematic look at seventeen years of blockchain and crypto in business: market cycles, corporate treasuries, ETF inflows, accounting standards, regulation, and systemic risk.

title: Cybersecurity Risk Disclosure After the SEC Mandate
summary: The SEC's 2023 cybersecurity disclosure rules created a new reporting regime. This brief maps the first years of filings, enforcement, and the research opportunities that follow.

title: Twenty Years of Textual Analysis in Accounting and Finance
summary: Textual analysis has grown from about 2 papers a year in 2005 to roughly 90 by 2023. This brief traces the methods, the data, and where the field is heading.

title: Can Google Trends Nowcast New Zealand Tourism?
summary: Search interest for 'new zealand holiday' correlates at 0.71 with monthly visitor arrivals over 2016-2026. The brief tests how useful that signal really is, and reviews AI adoption in the sector.

title: Understanding Large Language Models: A Primer for Accounting and Finance Researchers
summary: A plain-language guide to how LLMs work, what they can and cannot do, and why they matter for accounting and finance research and academic workflows.

title: What Has Generative AI Actually Changed in Everyday Life?
summary: The brief separates measurable change from hype: wellbeing aggregates have moved slowly and remain entangled with the pandemic recovery, while the most reliable effects so far are concentrated in work and skills.

title: Prompt Literacy: The New Workplace Skill With Accounting Implications
summary: The brief defines prompt literacy as crafting clear instructions, fixing poor responses, and knowing when a conversation with an AI is worth having - then shows where the evidence supports real economic value.
